transport: outbound HTTPS long poll plus authenticated heartbeat; browser uses server only
packaging: Windows executable; bundled approved Python runtime or equivalent packaging; ADB/fastboot paths configured, versions pinned
bootstrap: User generates one-time enrollment token in web; bridge exchanges it for scoped revocable credentials. No inbound PC port required.
journal: SQLite local journal fsync before any device side effect. Same command_id is queried, not re-executed. Results queued on disk while offline.
lease: Server row-lock claim plus increasing fencing token; PC holds local OS lock for physical device. Expiry while active/unknown quarantines device until reconciliation, never immediate reassignment.
identity: Explicit adb and fastboot identifiers plus registered board mapping; no first-connected-device selection. Ambiguous transition blocks.
flash: Profile owns partitions, slots, prerequisite unlock state and recovery steps. Unlock/wipe/relock never inferred by AI. Check image hash and board before execution.
cancellation: Defer stop to safe command boundary during flash; do not claim rollback. Record late remote result and reconcile before releasing lock.
manual: Human task records performer, image hash, device identity, timestamps, script version, expected cases and evidence. Do not record as automated execution.
offline: 10s heartbeat, 30s offline indication, 60s lease expiry defaults are configurable; local process may still be running.
secrets: No model keys or repository push credentials on bridge. Commands contain registered profiles, never arbitrary user-supplied host shell.
